However, she was so shocked that she staggered to the railing and fell through it to her death. Also, the TV producer overheard her conversation in the kitchen yesterday, declaring she would embarrass Yasumi with that trap. motive.quote: She admits to devising that trap because she hated Yasumi for her selfishness and arrogance.

method.quote: Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi.

evidence.quote: The detective found a strip of duct tape stuck on the tensil and declares that the culprit is Hiroko Shinohara, who has a roll of that same kind of tape.

motive.zhHans: 她承认设下那个陷阱，是因为她厌恶Yasumi的自私与傲慢。尽管Yasumi说过不会去查看舞台，但她还是去了，因为真凶把Hiroko的陷阱告诉了她。本质上，真凶把自己的陷阱设在Hiroko的陷阱之后，是为了让她当替罪羊来替罪，从而逃避嫌疑。Yukio今天早上擦了他的棕色皮鞋，但因为下着毛毛雨、湿度很高，鞋油没有干。由于Yasumi坠落时他和其他人在一起，烟雾机必须是遥控操作的。Yukio坦白，承认是他杀了Yasumi，因为她知道他在挪用节目的经费。
motive.en: She admits to devising that trap because she hated Yasumi for her selfishness and arrogance. Even though Yasumi said she would not check the stage, she went there anyway because the true culprit told her about Hiroko's trap. Essentially, the culprit put his trap behind Hiroko's so that he could use her as a scapegoat for the crime to avoid suspicion. Yukio polished his brown shoes this morning, but because it was drizzling and humid, the shoe polish did not dry. Since he was with everyone else during Yasumi's fall, the smoke machine had to be controlled wirelessly. Yukio confesses revealing that he killed Yasumi because she knew he was embezzling the program's funds.

method.zhHans: 有人设下陷阱要杀死Yasumi。她完全照他所说弄破了气球，却意外触发了真凶设下的第二个陷阱。第二件证据是他一直携带的、用来启动烟雾机的遥控器。然而，柯南用Yasumi留下的死前讯息反驳了他的说法：Yasumi在坠落时、在摔到地面上之前就意识到Yukio骗了她，因此在死前，她画下了一个在天气预报中代表雪的符号。
method.en: Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi. She did exactly what he told her and popped the balloon, which unexpectedly activated a second trap the culprit set up. The second piece of evidence is the remote control he was carrying the whole time to activate the smoke machine. However, Conan counters his claim with the dying message Yasumi had left: as Yasumi was falling she had realized that Yukio had tricked her before she fell onto the floor, so before she died, she drew a symbol that represents snow in weather forecasting.

evidence.zhHans: 侦探发现一条胶带粘在金属彩带上，并断言犯人是Hiroko Shinohara，她有一卷同样种类的胶带。小五郎的推理虽然并非全错，但无法解释为什么会有气体喷出的声音、为什么只有Yasumi头发的左侧被缠住，以及为什么她的发饰被发现靠近墙边。证明他是犯人的第一件证据，是烟雾机喷口上褐色的污迹。第二件证据是他一直携带的、用来启动烟雾机的遥控器。
evidence.en: The detective found a strip of duct tape stuck on the tensil and declares that the culprit is Hiroko Shinohara, who has a roll of that same kind of tape. Kogoro's deduction, while not entirely wrong, does not explain why there was the sound of gas spraying, why only the left side of Yasumi's hair was tangled, and why her hair accessory was found near the wall. The first piece of evidence that he is culprit is the brown smudge on the smoke machine's funnel. The second piece of evidence is the remote control he was carrying the whole time to activate the smoke machine.

resolution.zhHans: 小五郎告诉大家，这不是意外。有人设下陷阱要杀死Yasumi。要制造这个陷阱，把金属彩带的一端绑在舞台的一个支撑物上，另一端绑到对面；之后，把一个气球绑在彩带的另一端。当有人走下舞台时，脚会把金属彩带挑起来，将气球推向玫瑰的刺，使气球破裂。
resolution.en: Kogoro tells everyone that this was not an accident. Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi. To create the trap, tie one end of a tinsel to one of the stage's supports and the other end to the opposite side; after that, tie a balloon to other end of the tinsel. When a person walks down the stage, his or her foot scoops up the tinsel, pushing the balloon towards the roses' thorns and causing it to pop.

summary.en: Kogoro is at Nichiuri TV office, filming "Detective VS Weather Reporter" with Yasumi Sekine while Conan and Ran watch at the sidelines with Yukio Kodama, Takuya Yamaguchi, and Hiroko Shinohara. After the filming, Kogoro and Ran rest in a room while Conan goes to a vending machine to buy a bottle of oolong tea. As he picks up the bottle, he notices Yasumi and Yukio conversing secretly. After the small talk, they head out and split off. Then, Takuya hesitantly comes out of a room and follows Yasumi, and Conan follows him. Yasumi meets with Hiroko, who tells her the stage is good and ready. Hiroko asks her if she wanted to check the stage, but she said no because she trusted her.
